description: Interpretation of retained native AWS Resource Groups captures. Raw requests, responses, HTTP statuses and request IDs remain in native.json, native-query-boundaries.json and native-attributes.json; native-audit.json contains exact-owned CloudTrail events. This file does not replace them.

safety.mutations: Only uniquely named empty S3 buckets, SQS queues, Resource Groups, and two tiny CloudFormation stacks containing one SQS queue each. Empty capacity/network configuration groups do not allocate specialty resources.
safety.account_settings: GetAccountSettings only; GroupLifecycleEventsStatus INACTIVE. No PutAccountSettings, IAM role creation, AppRegistry provisioning, organization changes, instances, capacity reservations, dedicated hosts or firewalls.
safety.retained_history: CloudFormation retains deleted stack history. DELETE_COMPLETE and exact queue absence are the cleanup criteria; no claim that AWS deletes historical stack metadata.

rules: AWS::AllSupported includes AWS::ResourceGroups::Group, including the querying group itself when its tags match.
An omitted Values field and an empty Values array match any value for the specified key, but not a missing key.
Values:[""] matches an actual empty tag value, not a missing key.
Values within one filter are OR; different tag keys are AND; tag values are case-sensitive.
Repeated TagFilters with the same Key use the last filter: stage:red followed by stage:blue selected the blue bucket, not an empty intersection.
ResourceTypeFilters restrict selection; S3 and SQS type filters form a union.
Query update immediately changed the returned membership to the blue bucket; a rejected invalid update left the previously valid query unchanged.
selection.initial_hypotheses: The first raw native.json intentionally retains four matches:false annotations from pre-native expectations: selection-owner, selection-empty-values, selection-values-or omitted the owned groups; selection-duplicate-key-and assumed AND for repeated keys. Responses are not rewritten. The repeatable script now includes the owned groups and uses last-duplicate-key semantics. All ten captured result sets were checked against these calibrated expectations without repeating native failures.

rules: Query JSON field names are case-sensitive at both root and TagFilter member levels.
Unknown fields, malformed JSON, arrays, missing ResourceTypeFilters and empty objects are BadRequestException query syntax errors.
ResourceTypeFilters requires 1..100 elements; TagFilters requires 1..50; an empty tag Key is invalid.
Unsupported types, duplicate types, and AWS::AllSupported combined with another type are rejected.
Invalid pagination tokens and MaxResults=0 return modeled BadRequestException.

lifecycle_tags_and_pagination.evidence: native.json: no-query-or-configuration, duplicate-name, missing-group-identifier, conflicting-identifiers, description-*, group-tags*, group-untag-missing, groups-pagination-*
rules: CreateGroup requires a resource query or a supported service configuration; no default empty generic group is created.
A duplicate name is BadRequestException. Missing group names are NotFoundException; missing identifier or supplying Group plus GroupName is BadRequestException.
Clearing Description with an empty string omits it from the returned Group.
Tag returns only submitted tags; GetTags returns merged state. Untag tolerates missing keys and echoes the requested Keys. aws:-prefixed tag keys are rejected.
ListGroups returns both Groups and GroupIdentifiers. ListGroupResources returns both Resources.Identifier and ResourceIdentifiers plus QueryErrors.
Pagination can return an empty final page and filtered ListGroups can return an empty intermediate page with NextToken; continuation must follow the token rather than result count.

application_attributes_and_member_filter.evidence: native-attributes.json: create-displayname, create-owner, create-criticality, update-displayname, update-owner, update-criticality, ordinary-group-after-attributes, filter-*, member-filter-outside-query-types
rules: DisplayName, Owner and Criticality each produce BadRequestException Unsupported parameter for this operation on both CreateGroup and UpdateGroup for an ordinary tag-query group. The existing group remains unchanged.
ListGroups accepts display-name, owner and criticality filters; these probes returned empty arrays, including an intermediate empty page with a continuation token.

ListGroupResources rejects a resource-type filter outside the group's declared query types: an SQS filter against an S3-only query returns BadRequestException Filters not valid: The resource types specified as filters in the request are incompatible with the group query: AWS::SQS::Queue.

configuration_and_association.evidence: native.json: generic-*, capacity-*, network-*, appregistry-*, application-group, query-group-*
rules: Standalone AWS::ResourceGroups::Generic is rejected, including no parameters, S3 allowed-resource-types, capacity allowed-resource-types and unknown parameters.
CapacityReservationPool requires Generic with allowed-resource-types AWS::EC2::CapacityReservation. A correct empty pool succeeds with GroupConfiguration.Status UPDATE_COMPLETE.
An identical PutGroupConfiguration succeeds with an empty response; an empty configuration list is rejected and preserves the previous configuration.

Capacity GroupResources/UngroupResources with an S3 ARN succeeds at the HTTP level but returns Failed ResourceArnValidationException, Succeeded:[], Pending:[]. A nonexistent capacity-reservation ARN instead returns Failed ResourceGroupsValidationException.

Query groups reject both GroupResources and UngroupResources; the NetworkFirewall group rejects GroupResources. Query groups reject GetGroupConfiguration/PutGroupConfiguration and capacity groups reject GetGroupQuery.
ListGroupingStatuses requires an application group; query and capacity groups return BadRequestException, while an absent group returns NotFoundException.

NetworkFirewall::RuleGroup plus an EC2::Instance tag query is accepted. A missing query, S3 type, or AllSupported type is rejected. Primary Network Firewall documentation also lists EC2::NetworkInterface as eligible; no native interface was provisioned.

AppRegistry::Application and CloudFormation::Stack service configurations are ForbiddenException, managed by AppRegistry. ResourceGroups::ApplicationGroup direct creation is BadRequestException Operation is not supported.

evidence: native.json: stack-search, stack-members, stack-members-type-exclusion, stack-name-identifier, cleanup/stack-group-after-stack-delete
native-query-boundaries.json: empty-stack-identifier, nonexistent-stack-arn, stack-before-early-search, stack-create-in-progress-search, stack-query
rules: A real tiny CloudFormation stack selected its SQS queue ARN. Resource-type exclusion returned an empty list.
StackIdentifier requires an ARN: a plain stack name and an empty string are rejected.
SearchResources with a syntactically valid nonexistent stack ARN is HTTP200 with QueryErrors CLOUDFORMATION_STACK_NOT_EXISTING; CreateGroup with the same query is BadRequestException.
CREATE_IN_PROGRESS was observed immediately before successful SearchResources and successful CreateGroup. The early search had no resources and no QueryErrors; it was not rejected as inactive.

After DELETE_COMPLETE the group persists; ListGroupResources returns empty arrays and QueryErrors CLOUDFORMATION_STACK_INACTIVE. Native message lists DELETE_COMPLETE, ROLLBACK_COMPLETE and CREATE_FAILED as inactive statuses.

Primary query documentation explicitly lists CREATE_COMPLETE, CREATE_IN_PROGRESS, DELETE_FAILED, DELETE_IN_PROGRESS and REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS as supported; only CREATE_IN_PROGRESS, CREATE_COMPLETE and DELETE_COMPLETE were directly exercised.

StartTagSyncTask returned ForbiddenException for every tested selector variant because GLE is in maintenance mode and unavailable to new customers as of July 30, 2026. That gate ran before selector/group/role validation; these captures do not establish the later validation order.

A successful task needs a real managed application group and a service-assumable IAM tagging role with resource tagging/grouping permissions. Neither is provisioned by this capture; no successful enrollment or synchronization is claimed.
ListTagSyncTasks returns TagSyncTasks:[] for ordinary or nonexistent GroupName/GroupArn filters. An empty filter and a filter containing both fields are BadRequestException.
GetTagSyncTask and CancelTagSyncTask for a nonexistent task return NotFoundException Cannot find task: ARN.
unavailable: GLE enrollment for this current INACTIVE native account.
Exact-owned AppRegistry-managed application and service-assumable tagging role.
Positive capacity-reservation or dedicated-host association and underlying network/firewall resolution resources.

cloudtrail.collection: One bounded read-only lookup: 174 events matching the three exact capture prefixes, six lookup pages, no missing owned-prefix request IDs and no page-cap truncation. Credential fields removed recursively. Calls without an exact-owned prefix in their request are not part of this completeness statement.
rules: The native eventSource is resource-groups.amazonaws.com. The unhyphenated resourcegroups.amazonaws.com lookup returned no events.
All retained events have eventCategory Management, eventType AwsApiCall and managementEvent true.

Observed Get/List/Search calls have readOnly true and responseElements null, including failed reads. Observed mutations have readOnly false and populated responseElements, including failed mutations with a Message object.

The resources field was present for GetGroup, GetGroupQuery, GetGroupConfiguration and ListGroupResources, containing accountId, type AWS::ResourceGroups::Group and ARN. It was retained even on NotFound. Other observed operations omitted the resources field.
Observed failed events retain errorCode but omit errorMessage. Mutation error details instead appear in responseElements.Message.

CloudTrail can retain response members omitted by the generated SDK: CreateGroup includes Group.OwnerId and successful PutGroupConfiguration includes GroupIdentifier and GroupConfiguration. The retained raw audit shape is not a copy of SDK-decoded output.
Tag requestParameters.Arn is URL-encoded in the observed native audit event.
cloudtrail.absence_boundary: Missing or late CloudTrail records are not proof of native omission. This collection happened after the probes; no broader service-wide event coverage is claimed.
